headline: Alabama's New Law Permits the Expungement of Criminal Records
snippet: Alabama's first expungement law for nonviolent charges that were dismissed or acquitted.

headline: Expungement data shows majority of petitions granted
snippet: 586 petitions filed, 413 approved (70%+) since law took effect.

headline: From the Alabama Lawyer: Expungement of Criminal Records
snippet: Sen. Bedford sponsored after constituents couldn't get jobs due to dismissed arrest records.
